name: vayaplan-monorepo
description: VayaPlan — Plataforma ultra-ágil de ocio hiperlocal para ciudades intermedias

scripts.docker:up: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d db api
scripts.migrate: docker exec -i vayaplan_postgres psql -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-vayaplan_user} -d vayaplan < infra/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql
scripts.seed: docker exec -i vayaplan_postgres psql -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-vayaplan_user} -d vayaplan < infra/seed.sql
